span.p:
Level 1: INITIAL
Ad-hoc, Reactive
Characteristics:
• Minimal documentation
• Informal processes
• Individual heroics
Typical Behaviors:
• 'Just trying things out'
• AI is a side project
• No formal policies

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 2: DEVELOPING
Foundational Structure
Characteristics:
• Basic policies
• Assigned roles (part-time)
• Documented awareness
Investment: 1-2 FTE
<$100K
Timeline: 3-6 months

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 3: DEFINED
Systematic Processes
Characteristics:
• Formal processes
• Regular reviews
• Dedicated team
Investment: 2-4 FTE
$150K-$300K
Timeline: 6-12 months

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Level 4: MANAGED
Data-Driven
Characteristics:
• Quantitative management
• Continuous monitoring
• Process optimization
Investment: 4-6 FTE
$500K+
Timeline: 12-18 months

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 5: OPTIMIZING
Continuous Innovation
Characteristics:
• Industry leadership
• Advanced research
• Proactive anticipation
Investment: 6+ FTE
$1M+
Timeline: 18+ months
